claim: *Correspondence strength and governing role are independent.* DocAble's execution machinery consumes an explicit computation model to determine remediation composition. A separate analytical graph view projects that structure and is held in correspondence with its upstream declarations. Stronger correspondence makes the view more trustworthy as a representation; it does not make the view govern execution.
